rationale: Strategic Venue Partners remains a qualifying U.S. neutral-host wireless-infrastructure platform. Tiger Infrastructure Partners Fund II is the current controlling owner with a manager-recorded 2019 initial investment, while Brookfield's Infrastructure Structured Solutions Fund completed a direct minority investment on December 11, 2024. A March 2025 refinancing release confirms both current positions. The repository should add Brookfield/BISS as an owner, correct the 2017 company launch and 2019 Tiger entry chronology, and remove the unrelated 2022 BusinessWire claim. No later exit or pending ownership transaction was identified.
recommendedChanges: Retain one Strategic Venue Partners record at strategic-venue-partners|united-states and keep all venues, systems and asset SPVs beneath it.
Keep Tiger Infrastructure Partners Fund II as the active controlling owner with a 2019 entry year and an undisclosed exact percentage.
Add Brookfield Asset Management's BISS and institutional partners as an active minority owner from the December 11, 2024 close, with exact stake and vehicle not publicly disclosed.
Correct the company founding/launch year to 2017 and distinguish Tiger's 2017 financing support from its recorded 2019 portfolio investment.
Remove the unrelated March 2022 BusinessWire link and the resulting 2022 Tiger-entry claim.
Preserve the March 2025 $120 million refinancing as evidence of continuing Tiger control and Brookfield minority ownership, not as a new equity transaction.
unresolvedQuestions: Fully diluted percentages and management rollover are not publicly disclosed.
The exact Tiger and Brookfield holding SPVs, security and governance rights are not publicly disclosed.
The 2024 seller, consideration and primary-versus-secondary split are not publicly disclosed.
Tiger's exact legal close date is not publicly disclosed; the manager records 2019 as the initial investment year.
